expectations.text: The response asks exactly one question, not multiple bundled questions
expectations.evidence: Four numbered questions plus several inline ones — heavily bundled.

expectations.text: The opening question uses the format: a bold 'Q:' line followed by a bold 'Recommendation:' line
expectations.evidence: No Q:/Recommendation structure; long multi-section essay.

expectations.text: The recommendation takes a concrete position rather than saying 'it depends' or leaving it open
expectations.evidence: Takes concrete positions (Postgres, multi-location from day one).

expectations.text: The question is phrased in plain business language and does NOT use DDD jargon (bounded context, ubiquitous language, subdomain, anti-corruption layer, ACL, core domain) in the question text shown to the user
expectations.evidence: No DDD jargon present (stays in data-model terms).

expectations.text: Because no CONTEXT-MAP.yaml or CONTEXT.yaml exists, the response either asks the user how the file structure should look or proposes a starting structure
expectations.evidence: Proposes a relational DB schema, not the context-doc file structure; never asks where CONTEXT files should live.
